# Reality matrix

| Component | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Neuron identities | Data-derived | Root IDs from the loaded pack. |
| Connectivity | Data-derived | Weighted neuron-pair graph; not every molecular synapse property. |
| Transmitter class | Predicted/data-derived | Used to assign presynaptic sign. |
| LIF dynamics | Modeled | Shared equations and mostly global parameters. |
| Initial living state | Unknown | Natural/Connectome add disclosed stochastic hypotheses. |
| Retina geometry | Modeled | 64 angular samples in a 2D chamber. |
| Receptive-field mapping | Partly proxy | Exact fly receptive fields are unavailable for most cells. |
| Odor fields | Modeled | Smooth, noisy concentration fields. |
| VNC and locomotor rhythms | Modeled | Walk bouts, finite saccades and contact reflexes. |
| Six-leg biomechanics | Not simulated | The body is planar. |
| Physiology | Modeled | Energy, water, fatigue, stress and sleep pressure. |
| Memory | Modeled hypothesis | Dead-reckoned, drifting associative traces. |
| Personal history | Simulated state | Numerical brain/body/memory state persists and can be saved. |
| Biological life | Not established | The model is software. |
| Consciousness | Unknown/not established | No accepted test is supplied. |
